title: A point of the (m+1)-skeleton off the m-skeleton lies on an open unit lattice (m+1)-face (parent step 4)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and x ∈ ℝ^P (Euclid P). Assume (i) x ∈ L_{m+1}: there is a set s of coordinate indices with P ≤ m + 1 + |s| and x_i ∈ ℤ for every i ∈ s; and (ii) x ∉ L_m: there is no set s of coordinate indices with P ≤ m + |s| and x_i ∈ ℤ for every i ∈ s. Then x lies on an open unit lattice (m+1)-face: there are a strictly increasing ι : Fin (m+1) → Fin P, b ∈ ℤ^P and y ∈ ℝ^{m+1} with 0 < y_j < 1 for every j such that x = b + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)} (in Lean: WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (b i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (ι j) 1 = x, with p = (ι, b)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (x : Euclid P), (∃ s : Finset (Fin P), P ≤ m + 1 + s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, x i = z) → (¬ ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), P ≤ m + s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, x i = z) → ∃ (p : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ)) (y : Euclid (m + 1)), StrictMono p.1 ∧ (∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1) ∧ WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ) = x
